frontmatter.title: TTT-Discover: Learning to Discover at Test Time
frontmatter.author: Mert Yuksekgonul, Daniel Koceja, Xinhao Li, Federico Bianchi, Jed McCaleb, Xiaolong Wang, Jan Kautz, Yejin Choi, James Zou, Carlos Guestrin, Yu Sun, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: TTT-Discover keeps training the LLM on a single test problem instead of prompting a frozen one. It runs RL on the test problem itself, using an objective built for discovery rather than average performance — beating the top human on TriMul kernels and setting records on Erdős minimum overlap.
